title: DashboardReading
description: Reading dashboard data consumed by the reading widget. The articles array is a simplified display projection of LP articles-export data; fields are renamed and reduced for consumer-site rendering. The stats object is DS-computed.

articles.description: Recently saved articles projected from LP articles-export. Field names are simplified relative to the LP export (e.g. 'title' instead of 'articleTitle').

examples: Why SQLite Is So Great for the Edge

date.description: Human-readable relative or formatted date string.

category.description: Topic category label for display filtering.

starred.description: Whether the article has been starred/highlighted by the user.

stats.description: Aggregate reading statistics computed by the DS pipeline from LP articles-export data.

totalSubscriptions.description: Total number of active feed subscriptions.

unreadCount.description: Total number of unread articles across all subscriptions.

articlesThisWeek.description: Number of articles saved or read in the current calendar week.

articlesLastWeek.description: Number of articles saved or read in the previous calendar week.
